UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile containing sync preferences, favorites list, and recently viewed channel history

userId.description: Unique user identifier matching Firebase Auth UID

recentlyViewed.description: List of recently viewed channel IDs (max 30)

allowAdultChannels.description: Whether adult NSFW channels are enabled

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created (submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp())

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated (submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp())

/users/{userId}.description: User preferences, favorites, theme, and watch history indexed by Firebase Auth UID
